A curated playlist for transparent, high-quality AI-assisted music. AI-assisted music is growing fast, and Spotify already lets artists disclose AI usage in song credits. However, high-quality, transparently labelled AI tracks still have no clear discovery lane and often get buried among low-effort or spam uploads. I would love to see a curated, editorial-quality playlist (or category) for AI-assisted music that meets a clear quality bar: original, rights-cleared, no unauthorized voice clones, and with AI usage clearly disclosed through the new credit system. This would give listeners a trusted way to discover good AI music, help serious AI artists
